## Report — V6 capture-time path-scope trust boundary (B1)

**Landed the capture-side half of the V6-AUTH-1 fix** so out-of-project file bytes are refused *before* persistence, closing the at-rest leak the retrieval gate couldn't reach. Exclusive files only; no Git/config/schema/interface/wire changes.

**New single source of truth — `internal/hookio/capture_scope.go`** (hookio→paths is within the documented "foundation" allow-set, no cycle): `CaptureScope`/`CaptureScopeRaw` check **every** structured path (`file_path`/`path`/`notebook_path`/`edits[]`, no command parsing) with **`Norm` + `ResolvesInside`** (lexical + physical junction/mount awareness). Three verdicts — `OutOfProject` (proven escape, refuses everywhere), `Unprovable` (dropped/cut path; archive-data at the full gate, byte-drop only in the fragment case), `Allow`.

**Enforcement points:**
- **observer/tooluse.go** — stops swallowing the `Norm` error into an empty path; a proven escape returns *before* `PutBytes` (no bytes, no record, no file-version), terminal, counted `observer.capture_out_of_scope`. `ResolvesInside` added.
- **daemon/handlers.go** — `admitDelivery` enforces scope on a **supplied OK capture** (judged from the retained `Event`, never re-parsing redacted `Capture.Bytes` — the forged-OKcap bypass) and on the no-capture path *before* the redaction policy runs. Refusals reuse the terminal `Denied` verdict + new `l0_admission_scope_denied` counter.
- **cli/capture_admission.go** — `scopeGuardCapture` runs before the spool/WAL: an OK escape becomes a byte-free `Denied`; a degraded fragment drops bytes for any non-in-scope answer (no opaque outside-file bytes retained), while pathless fragments keep their redacted evidence.

**No new schema** — existing denied/CaptureError states reused; denial persists nothing and is audited via counters/logs with no raw target paths.

**Tests** (28, `GOMAXPROCS=2`, all pass): absolute/traversal/**junction-symlink**/multi-mixed escapes, forged-OK bypass, fragment no-leak, inside & pathless controls. The symlink defense skips on Windows and was **run for real on Linux via WSL2 cross-compile** (PASS). Regression: `cli TestHookCapture*` redaction flow and `daemon TestDrain|TestDelivery|TestAdmit` pass; `gofmt`/`vet` clean. Work record at `plans/sdd/V6-remediation/capture-work.md`.

**Returned to main (not emulated here):** V6-HOST-1 native/live host-Read policy is unsupported in-protocol — a product decision (A/B/C). B2 pathless (Bash) laundering is structural (redaction-only); B3 metadata is MCP-owned.
